# RPC reference (generated by `tools/gen_api_docs.py` from the live schema)

Call with `POST {SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/rpc/<name>`, JSON body = named parameters, headers `apikey: <anon key>` and `Authorization: Bearer <user JWT>` (kiosk/anon functions: anon key only). Errors come back as HTTP 400 with `{"message":"<code>"}`.

## customer

| Function | Parameters | Returns | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `home_feed` | `-` | `jsonb` | ONE request for the home screen: enabled categories, promos, book-again. ~1 KB. |
| `create_job` | `p_category smallint, p_lat double precision, p_lng double precision, p_address text, p_phone text, p_description text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_photos text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[], p_scheduled timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_pay pay_method DEFAULT 'cash'::pay_method, p_scrap jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()` | `uuid` | Create a booking of any type (instant / scheduled / quote; scrap items via `p_scrap`). Validates category enabled + region enabled, stores the exact address in `job_private`, snaps public location to ~500 m, then dispatches offers. Errors: `auth_required category_unavailable area_not_served bad_schedule photos_required scrap_items_required`. |
| `accept_quote` | `p_quote uuid` | `void` | Pick one of up to 3 quotes; locks price, rejects the others. Errors: `quote_gone not_allowed`. |
| `submit_review` | `p_job uuid, p_rating smallint, p_comment text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_tip integer DEFAULT 0` | `void` | Rate (1-5) a DONE job, optional tip. One review per job. |
| `repeat_job` | `p_job uuid, p_every_days smallint, p_auto_book boolean DEFAULT false` | `void` | Repeat a DONE job every N days. `p_auto_book=true` (weekly cleaning): the sweep creates + dispatches the next scheduled job. `false` (aircond every 120 days): customer gets a reminder push instead. |
| `my_addresses` | `-` | `TABLE(id uuid, label text, line text, lat double precision, lng double precision)` | Saved addresses as lat/lng (max 20). |
| `add_address` | `p_label text, p_line text, p_lat double precision, p_lng double precision` | `uuid` | Save an address pin. |
| `nearby_providers` | `p_category smallint, p_lat double precision, p_lng double precision, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10` | `TABLE(id uuid, full_name text, photo_url text, rating_avg numeric, rating_count integer, distance_m integer, from_price_cents integer)` | Public provider cards (name, rating, distance, from-price) within 30 km, nearest first. |
| `nearby_shops` | `p_lat double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_lng double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0` | `TABLE(id uuid, name text, kind text, address text, open boolean, distance_m integer, waiting integer, wait_secs integer)` | Open queue shops with live waiting count and estimated wait; ordered by distance when lat/lng given. Max 20 per call; `p_offset` for paging. |
| `join_queue` | `p_shop uuid` | `queue_tickets` | Take a ticket (idempotent: returns the existing active ticket). Error `shop_closed`. |
| `cancel_ticket` | `p_ticket uuid` | `void` | Leave the queue. |
| `ticket_position` | `p_ticket uuid` | `jsonb` | `{number,status,ahead,wait_secs,serving}` for the caller's own ticket. |

## both

| Function | Parameters | Returns | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `report_problem` | `p_job uuid, p_reason text` | `uuid` | Report a problem within 7 days of completion/cancellation. Error `report_window_closed`. |
| `send_sos` | `p_job uuid, p_lat double precision, p_lng double precision` | `void` | Emergency alert with one-shot location; appears in the admin SOS list. |
| `job_contact` | `p_job uuid` | `TABLE(address_line text, lat double precision, lng double precision, contact_phone text)` | Exact address + phone of a job. Returns rows only for the customer, or for the assigned provider (until 7 days after completion). Otherwise empty. |
| `delete_my_account` | `-` | `void` | PDPA erasure: deletes addresses, tokens, exact job addresses; anonymises profile and chat; disables sign-in. Job rows are kept anonymised for accounting. |
| `set_job_status` | `p_job uuid, p_to job_status` | `void` | Provider: accepted→on_the_way→arrived→in_progress→done. Either party may cancel before in_progress. Errors: `bad_transition price_required use_complete_scrap not_allowed`. On `done`: commission computed, tracking row deleted. |

## customer→provider

| Function | Parameters | Returns | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `become_provider` | `p_categories smallint[], p_radius numeric, p_ic_last4 text, p_lat double precision, p_lng double precision` | `void` | Create provider profile (status `pending`). Requires PDPA consent. Admin must approve. |

## provider

| Function | Parameters | Returns | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `set_online` | `p_online boolean, p_lat double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_lng double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision` | `void` | Go online/offline with a single position fix. Error `not_approved_provider`. |
| `accept_offer` | `p_job uuid` | `void` | First-to-accept wins (atomic UPDATE). Errors: `offer_expired already_taken not_approved_provider`. |
| `decline_offer` | `p_job uuid` | `void` | Decline an offer. |
| `submit_quote` | `p_job uuid, p_price integer, p_message text DEFAULT NULL::text` | `uuid` | Send/update a quote (max 3 quotes per job, DB-enforced). Errors `not_quotable quote_limit`. |
| `set_final_price` | `p_job uuid, p_price integer` | `void` | Set final price (sen) while arrived/in_progress. |
| `complete_scrap` | `p_job uuid, p_items jsonb` | `integer` | Enter actual kg per item; payout = Σ round(kg × per-kg rate); marks job done. Returns payout in sen. |
| `ping_location` | `p_job uuid, p_lat double precision, p_lng double precision, p_heading smallint DEFAULT NULL::smallint` | `void` | Live location for an ACTIVE job only (accepted/on_the_way/arrived); server throttles to 1 write / 4 s. Error `not_active`. |
| `provider_earnings` | `p_days integer DEFAULT 30` | `jsonb` | `{jobs,gross,commission,tips,scrap_payouts,net}` for the last N days. |

## shop staff

| Function | Parameters | Returns | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `queue_next` | `p_shop uuid` | `queue_tickets` | NEXT: finishes the current ticket (updates avg service time) and calls the next waiting number. |
| `queue_recall` | `p_shop uuid` | `queue_tickets` | RECALL: re-announces the current number (re-triggers push + TV). |
| `queue_skip` | `p_shop uuid` | `queue_tickets` | SKIP: marks the current number skipped and calls the next. |
| `kiosk_pair_claim` | `p_code text, p_shop uuid, p_name text DEFAULT 'Kiosk'::text` | `void` | Staff app claims a kiosk pairing code (from the QR) for a shop. Error `bad_code`. |

## shop staff / kiosk

| Function | Parameters | Returns | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `queue_snapshot` | `p_shop uuid` | `jsonb` | `{serving,waiting,wait_secs,open}` for a shop. Contains no personal data. |

## kiosk (anon)

| Function | Parameters | Returns | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kiosk_pair_start` | `-` | `text` | Pi asks for a 10-char pairing code (valid 10 min); shows it as QR `giliranbox://pair?code=...`. |
| `kiosk_pair_poll` | `p_code text` | `jsonb` | Returns `{status: waiting|expired|paired, token?, shop_id?}`; the device token is returned ONCE. |

## kiosk (token)

| Function | Parameters | Returns | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kiosk_create_ticket` | `p_token text, p_client_id uuid, p_label text DEFAULT NULL::text` | `queue_tickets` | Online ticket creation; idempotent by `p_client_id`. |
| `kiosk_reserve_block` | `p_token text, p_size integer DEFAULT 50` | `jsonb` | Reserve up to 200 consecutive numbers for offline issuing. `{first,last,day}`. |
| `kiosk_sync` | `p_token text, p_tickets jsonb` | `jsonb` | Replay locally-issued tickets/status changes; idempotent by `client_id`. |
| `kiosk_call_next` | `p_token text` | `queue_tickets` | Same as NEXT, server-authoritative. |
| `kiosk_recall` | `p_token text` | `queue_tickets` | Same as RECALL. |
| `kiosk_snapshot` | `p_token text` | `jsonb` | Same as `queue_snapshot` for the paired shop. |

## admin

| Function | Parameters | Returns | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `admin_set_provider_status` | `p_provider uuid, p_status provider_status` | `void` | approve / reject / suspend. Approval fails with `license_missing` unless every licence required by the provider's categories (e.g. electrical competency, pest control) has an approved document. |
| `demand_heatmap` | `p_days integer DEFAULT 30` | `TABLE(lat double precision, lng double precision, jobs bigint, category_id smallint)` | 1 km grid of job counts for the last N days (+ category). |
| `admin_sos` | `-` | `TABLE(id uuid, who text, phone text, job_id uuid, lat double precision, lng double precision, created_at timestamp with time zone)` | Open SOS alerts with name, phone, coordinates. |
